name: object_contact_v3
changed_factors: v2 world-down and camera-ray approach hypotheses are retained
each admitted or permitted arrow-tail seed is promoted to a bounded visible upper surface
an 8-connected same-frame RGB-D top component replaces the point-local support patch
image-boundary rejection guards truncated target support
target contact is allowed only in the late measured finger/pad capture volume
local support surfaces below the promoted contact may be exempted only for measured finger/pad sweeps
all observed points remain in the full sweep; only late finger/pad contact volume is exempted
a robot-occluded arrow tail cannot seed fallback or model admission
prompt: Point to visible grasp contact locations on the {noun} at the tail, or start, of the green arrow. Ignore the arrowhead and destination. Choose locations where a parallel-jaw gripper can descend from above, straddle the object, and close without touching nearby objects or support surfaces. Point only on the {noun}.
